Bug 538459 - Wrong removal of redundant modifiers (static method in enum in interface)

Add cases for nested enums

- remove 'static' modifier from nested enum
- do not remove 'public' modifier from static methods in nested enums

Change-Id: I045e6b62044383f8f9bd513695797a22037cb7c5
Signed-off-by: Karsten Thoms <karsten.thoms@itemis.de>
dslRule:
<!id: remove.redundant.static.nested.enum>
<!description: Remove redundant 'static' modifier from a nested enum declaration. Nested enums are implicitly static.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!minJavaVersion: 8>

static enum $name { $body$ } :: parentMatches("class $parentName") || parentMatches("interface $parentName")
=> enum $name { $body$ }
;;
summary: Remove redundant 'static' from nested enum declarations.

commitMessage:
Bug 539289 - "Surround With try/catch" should revert "var" initializer.

- "Surround With try/catch" moves the variable initializer into the "try"
while creating a null initializer declaration outside. However, it is a
compile-time error for the local variable type to be "var", with a null
initializer. The "var" type must be changed to the inferred type.
- When "var" must be replaced with the inferred type, the quick fix
label should describe the additional steps taken
- Create helper ASTNodes.isVarType(..) to determine if a given
ASTNode is either a SimplNameVariable or DeclarationStatement whose type
is 'var'
- Use ASTNodes.isVarType(..) in
QuickAssistProcessor.getConvertVarTypeToResolvedTypeProposal(..)

Change-Id: I63d315afdf5f86ddfb5c85dacebafcc956a8c6c7
Signed-off-by: Roland Grunberg <rgrunber@redhat.com>
summary: This commit fixes a bug in the 'Surround With try/catch' refactoring, preventing it from generating invalid 'var' declarations (e.g., 'var x;') by instead converting 'var' to its resolved type within the refactoring logic.
